issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be a static method (it must use the shared stock and the notes list it as static), but the reference implementation declares calculateTotalPrice as an instance method. This mismatch (static vs instance) can confuse students about the intended API and how to call the method (SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(...) vs instance.calculateTotalPrice(...)) and may lead to implementations that do not match the tests or the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the declaration of calculateTotalPrice consistent with the problem statement. Either (A) change the solution to declare calculateTotalPrice as static: public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal) { ... } so it uses the shared static stock as intended, or (B) if the intended design is instance-based, update the problem statement to remove the requirement that calculateTotalPrice be static and clarify the intended usage. Prefer (A) to follow the current specification that the method uses the shared stock.
